# harvester_kubeovn_vpc (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harvester_kubeovn_vpc" "example" {
  name = "my-vpc"

  namespaces = ["default", "my-namespace"]

  static_routes {
    cidr        = "192.0.2.0/24"
    next_hop_ip = "10.0.0.254"
  }

  policy_routes {
    priority = 10
    match    = "ip4.src == 10.0.0.0/24"
    action   = "allow"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A unique name

### Optional

- `description` (String) Any text you want that better describes this resource
- `enable_bfd` (Boolean) Use BFD on the external connection of the VPC.
- `enable_external` (Boolean) Connect the VPC router to the external network.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `namespaces` (List of String) Namespaces allowed to use the subnets of the VPC.
- `policy_routes` (Block List) Policy routes of the VPC router. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--policy_routes))
- `static_routes` (Block List) Static routes of the VPC router. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--static_routes))
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `default_subnet` (String) Default subnet of the VPC.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `message` (String)
- `router` (String) Name of the OVN logical router of the VPC.
- `standby` (Boolean) Whether kube-ovn has created the VPC router.
- `state` (String)
- `subnets` (List of String) Subnets of the VPC.

<a id="nestedblock--policy_routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policy_routes`

Required:

- `action` (String) allow, drop, or reroute to next_hop_ip.
- `match` (String) OVN match expression, for example "ip4.src == 10.0.1.0/24".
- `priority` (Number) Priority of the policy, the highest first.

Optional:

- `next_hop_ip` (String) Next hop address of a reroute policy.


<a id="nestedblock--static_routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `static_routes`

Required:

- `cidr` (String) Destination or source CIDR of the route.
- `next_hop_ip` (String) Next hop address.

Optional:

- `ecmp_mode` (String) ECMP mode of the route.
- `policy` (String) Match the destination (policyDst) or the source (policySrc) address. kube-ovn uses policyDst when it is omitted.
- `route_table` (String) Route table of the route.
